name: socless
description: Live schematic view of Chisel designs, linked to the source.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: SoCLess runs your build (Mill) and tests, which requires a trusted workspace.

socless.javaPath.description: Java 21+ executable that runs the SoCLess language server. Empty: $JAVA_HOME/bin/java, else java on the PATH.

socless.serverJar.description: SoCLess language server jar. Empty: the one bundled with the extension.

socless.waveFlag.description: ChiselSim option that turns waveforms on for Simulate, passed to ScalaTest as -D<flag>=1 (emitVcd is ChiselSim's; a project may define its own, such as emitFst).

socless.surferCommand.description: The Surfer executable that Simulate starts on the trace (run as <command> --wcp-initiate <port> <trace>, or <command> <trace> for a Surfer without --wcp-initiate).

socless.waveViewer.description: Where Simulate shows the trace: surfer (the external Surfer app), surfer-panel (Surfer embedded in the SoCLess panel), or custom (socless.waveViewerCommand).

socless.waveViewerCommand.description: Command line for the custom viewer, split on whitespace (no quoting, no shell); {file} is replaced by the trace path, for example: gtkwave {file}.

socless.wavesFollowSelection.description: Surfer viewers only: the module selected in the SoCLess panel decides which signals Surfer shows, and a smaller selection moves its focus.

socless.wavesShowClockReset.description: Surfer viewers only: list clock and reset first in the signal list.

socless.wavesFoldBundles.description: `surfer-panel` only (the Surfer app's list has no groups): start bundle sub-groups folded in the signal list.

socless.wavesShowWires.description: Surfer viewers only: include a Wires group (the module's wires and named nodes) in the signal list.

socless.wavesColorByDirection.description: Surfer viewers only: colour signals by direction (inputs blue, outputs green); otherwise all ports are blue.

socless.wavesFollowDelayMs.description: Surfer viewers only: delay in milliseconds after a selection change before Surfer is updated.

socless.followCursor.description: The class under the editor's cursor lights its boxes in the schematic and dims the rest. The panel's Focus chip turns it off until the cursor moves to another class.

socless.schematicColorizeComponents.description: Schematic: colour the boxes by kind (instances, registers, operators, memories, state machines, logic blocks).

socless.schematicColorizeWires.description: Schematic: colour the wires by bundle type.

socless.schematicDensity.description: Schematic: how tight the panel's chrome is.

socless.schematicLabelSize.description: Schematic: the size of port labels and box names, for reading a zoomed-out view.

socless.schematicAutoOptimize.description: Schematic: lay every view out with the optimize pass (fewer crossings, in the background).

socless.schematicHintBar.description: Schematic: the hint bar under the schematic, which says what the mouse does on what is under it.

socless.schematicShowLayers.description: Schematic: draw verification layers (asserts, assumes, covers).

socless.schematicHide.description: Schematic: node kinds to leave out (op operators, reg registers, const constants, mem memories, fsm state machines, block logic blocks).
